battle.name: 威懾寫進名冊
battle.brief: 一九四五年八月，兩次空襲把核武寫進美軍裝備名冊，同一張名冊上還留著 M1911 手槍。戰略轟炸交給戰略空軍，個人武器照舊隨身帶著；此後大國不敢直接對撞，局部戰爭仍用步槍、戰車與噴射機，核武只當天花板。

kit.name: M1911
kit.history: 0.45 口徑半自動手槍。一戰到越戰都在美軍副武器名冊上。

countries: 這場節點式戰爭只有一方具備主動出擊能力，出擊方是美國的戰略空軍。指揮鏈由駐本土的戰略空軍司令部與第五航空隊構成，具體執行單位是駐馬里亞納群島提尼安島的第五〇九混合大隊，轄第三九三、第三九四、第四六六三個 B-29 轟炸中隊，另有氣象、情報、通信、高射砲與維修中隊。防守方是日本帝國陸軍與海軍的本土防衛體系：廣島一帶由師團級部隊與市內防空兵力分區擔守，長崎一帶由海軍第五海軍根據地司令部的部隊與高射炮隊擔任，海軍航空隊的夜間戰鬥機與本土各機場的防空單位在九州外海與本州西南部迎擊來襲機隊，各部隊仍照戰時指揮鏈運作，帝國大本營統籌全局。英國政府在事前被告知原子彈將用於對日作戰，蘇聯未被告知；蘇軍在八月八日夜對滿洲的攻擊，使日本政府同時要處理兩個方向的壓力。
countriesEn: In this scenario war only one side is able to strike offensively, and the striker is the American strategic air arm. The chain of command runs from the Strategic Air Forces headquarters and the Fifth Air Force in the continental United States down to the 509th Composite Group stationed at Tinian in the Mariana Islands, which flies the 393rd, 394th and 466th B-29 bomb squadrons together with weather, intelligence, communications, antiaircraft and maintenance units. The defending side is the homeland defence system of the Imperial Japanese Army and Navy: around Hiroshima the ground was held by division-level formations and urban antiaircraft troops in sectors, while Nagasaki was covered by units of the Navy's Fifth Naval Base District together with antiaircraft batteries; night fighters of the naval air arm and antiaircraft units at the home islands' airfields intercepted the incoming force over the Kyushu approaches and the southwest of Honshu, and every formation still operated on its wartime chain of command under the Imperial General Headquarters. The British government was told in advance that the atomic bomb would be used against Japan; the Soviet Union was not. The Red Army's entry into Manchuria on the night of 8 August left the Japanese government under pressure from two directions at once.
people: 美方方面，曼哈頓工程區主任羅伯特·奧普爾曼主持工程，陸軍工兵部長萊斯利·格羅夫斯以軍事工程的身分監管，之下是分佈於新墨西哥、橡樹嶺與田納西的實驗與生產設施，峰值雇員逾十萬人。決定用不用武器的是總統杜魯門、戰爭部長史汀生與參謀長聯席會議，其主席為海軍上將哈爾西；八月四日與五日，史汀生把計畫通知駐日盟軍最高統帥麥克阿瑟，戰略空軍司令斯帕茲隨即向第五〇九大隊下令。執行層面上，第五〇九大隊大隊長李梅上校在提尼安指揮，第三九三轟炸中隊作戰主任蒂貝茲中校駕駛恩羅拉·蓋伊，機上十二人完成投彈，領航員吉本斯上尉負責高度與方位，轟炸員布蘭尼少校負責瞄準與相機；八月九日的主力機巴克夏由斯威尼少校駕駛，觀察員巴克上尉的名字留在機身上，另有大藝術家與大臭味兩架攜帶測量儀器的飛機承擔天氣判斷與儀表任務。日本方面，最高決策集中在以天皇為核心的御前會議與內閣，陸軍參謀本部與海軍軍令部在本土防衛部署上長期分歧，鈴木貫太郎內閣在八月十日的臨時閣議上決定接受宣言的附帶條件，本土各師團與防空部隊則依既定命令繼續作戰。
peopleEn: On the American side, Robert Oppenheimer directed the project as head of the Manhattan Engineer District and Leslie Groves supervised it as a military engineering project under the Corps of Engineers; below them sat the laboratories and production facilities spread across New Mexico, Oak Ridge and Tennessee, with a peak employment of more than one hundred thousand. The decision to use the weapon belonged to President Truman, Secretary of War Stimson and the Joint Chiefs of Staff, chaired at the time by Admiral Halsey; on 4 and 5 August Stimson informed the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers in Japan, MacArthur, and the Air Force commander Spaatz in turn ordered the 509th Composite Group into action. At the execution level, group commander Colonel LeMay directed the effort from Tinian, while Lieutenant Colonel Paul Tibbets, operations officer of the 393rd Bomb Squadron, flew the Enola Gay; the twelve men aboard completed the drop, with First Officer John Gibbons handling altitude and navigation and Major Thomas Blaney the sighting and camera. On 9 August the strike aircraft was Bockscar, flown by Major Charles Sweeney, with observer Captain Frederick Bock, whose name the aircraft carried; two other aircraft, the Great Artiste and the Big Stink, flew instrumentation and weather duties. On the Japanese side the highest decisions sat with the Imperial conferences around the Emperor and the cabinet; the Army General Staff and the Navy Naval Staff had disagreed for years over the deployment of the homeland defence, and the Suzuki cabinet decided at the emergency cabinet meeting of 10 August to accept the declaration with its stated conditions, while the divisions and antiaircraft units in the home islands continued to fight under standing orders.
kits: 把名冊攤開看，與這兩次出擊直接相關的是 B-29 超級堡壘：四台萊特 R-3350 星型雙排發動機，單台出力約一千六百匹馬力，最大升限約三萬五千英尺，帶彈作戰半徑超過兩千英里，四挺 M2 重機槍與尾部遙控砲塔構成自衛火力，機鼻可裝雷達瞄準設備，機身以代號標示。第五〇九大隊的 B-29 是全軍最先完成雷達投彈改裝的隊伍，彈艙掛架與艙門氣密旁通也為這類重量級彈藥而改。炸藥本身被當成一件有規格的裝備：八月六日投下的鈾彈藥型約重四噸半，尾部裝雷達引信與照相機校驗；八月九日投下的鈽彈藥型約重四噸六百公斤，改由目視投彈，測量交給另外兩架飛機。同一個月的名冊另一頭是 M1911 手槍：.45 口徑、七發單排供彈，1942 年之後的 M1911A1 換上較長套筒並加大握把安全，1945 年柯特停止生產時整個系列累計約一百五十萬支，它是美軍陸軍、海軍陸戰隊與海岸警衛隊的標準副武器。關鍵在於分工：這把手槍不會飛到日本去，它留在地面部隊、佔領部隊與警衛人員腰間；而那件以存在本身生效的裝備由 B-29 帶上天空。同一份名冊上，兩種完全不同的作用邏輯並排寫著。
kitsEn: Open the roster and the equipment directly connected to these two sorties is the B-29 Superfortress: four Wright R-3350 radial twin-row engines at roughly sixteen hundred horsepower each, a service ceiling near thirty-five thousand feet, a combat radius with bombs beyond two thousand miles, and four M2 .50 calibre machine guns with remote-controlled tail turrets as defensive armament, while the nose could take a radar sighting installation and the airframe carried unit markings. The 509th's B-29s were the first in the army to be modified for radar bombing, and the bomb racks and the bomb-bay pressurisation bypass were altered to carry loads of this weight. The bombs themselves were handled as equipment with specifications: the uranium weapon dropped on 6 August weighed about four and a half tonnes, with a radar fuze and camera verification in the tail, while the plutonium weapon dropped on 9 August weighed about four thousand six hundred kilograms and was released visually, with measurement left to two other aircraft. At the other end of the same roster sat the M1911: .45 calibre, seven rounds in a single magazine, and after 1942 the M1911A1 with a longer slide and an enlarged grip safety; when Colt stopped production in 1945 the family had reached roughly one and a half million pistols, and it was the standard sidearm of the US Army, Marine Corps and Coast Guard. The point is the division of labour: this pistol never flew to Japan, it stayed on the hips of ground troops, occupation units and security police, while the weapon that worked by existing was carried into the sky by the B-29. Two entirely different logics of effect sit side by side on the same roster.
tactics: 這不是一場有接觸的戰鬥，戰術只在幾個小時內完成。第五〇九大隊的做法是先由提尼安島的氣象中隊判斷目標上空的雲量與能見度，確定可用才放行；情報中隊提供廠區座標與相片，轟炸中隊按指定高度與航線起飛，在關島與塞班島一帶的中途加油點補滿燃料，全程以單機、幾乎沒有戰鬥機護衛的編隊突入，護衛由護衛驅逐艦上的戰鬥機在遠海擔當。目標上空約八千五百至九千四百五十公尺的高度平飛，炸彈從機腹釋放，由雷達與照相機把瞄準點對準廠區與船塢的交叉點。八月六日先由 B-25 大臭味做目視確認與天氣判斷，再由恩羅拉·蓋伊投彈；八月九日雲層過厚，主炸機延誤後改為目視投彈，儀表測量由大藝術家與另一架 B-29 補做。返航途中，日方夜間戰鬥機與高射砲多次逼近並造成損傷，同日進行相片偵察的 B-29 也有因燃料耗盡在台灣海峽與沖繩一帶迫降或墜海者。整個過程的戰術本質是精確與保密：不追求編隊與火力密度，只求一次投進指定座標。
tacticsEn: This was not a battle with contact; the tactics lasted only a few hours. The 509th first had its weather section on Tinian judge cloud cover and visibility over the target, and released the mission only once conditions were usable; the intelligence section supplied the plant coordinates and photographs, and the bombardment squadron took off on a set altitude and route, refuelling at the tanker turnpoints around Guam and Saipan, then penetrating as a single aircraft with essentially no fighter escort, the escort being provided further out by fighters from the escort carriers. The run over the target was flown level at roughly eight thousand five hundred to nine thousand four hundred and fifty metres, the weapon released from the belly, radar and camera aligning the aim point on the junction between the industrial plant and the shipyard. On 6 August the B-25 Big Stink made the visual check and the weather call, and the Enola Gay then made the drop; on 9 August the cloud was too thick, the strike aircraft was delayed and released visually, and instrumentation was completed by the Great Artiste and a second B-29. On the way back, Japanese night fighters and antiaircraft fire closed in repeatedly and caused damage, and several B-29s on the same day's photographic reconnaissance ditched or went down in the Taiwan Strait and around Okinawa after running out of fuel. The tactical essence of the whole operation was precision and secrecy: no mass of formation and no volume of fire, only a single release aimed at a fixed set of coordinates.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾處。試爆在 1945 年 7 月 16 日清晨於新墨西哥州阿拉莫戈陸軍航空場進行，常引用的當量估計落在一萬五千至兩萬一千噸之間，諸說並存。廣島的出擊在八月六日八時十五分，恩羅拉·蓋伊從約九千四百五十公尺高度投下鈾彈藥型，機上十二人；同日除主炸機外另有 B-25 一架與 B-29 十餘架擔任目視確認與相片偵察。長崎的出擊在八月九日十一時零二分，巴克夏從約八千五百公尺高度投下鈽彈藥型，出動 B-29 三架，另有兩架攜帶測量儀器。第五〇九混合大隊的總兵力約八千人，涵蓋飛行人員與地勤。製造端，柯特的 M1911 系列到 1945 年停產時累計約一百五十萬支，.45 口徑手槍每支配七發。曼哈頓工程區峰值雇員逾十萬人。戰後的核武庫年表顯示，美國在 1945 年底只有兩件用過的核裝置，存彈頭數在 1960 年代中期達到逾三萬枚的峰值，1989 年冷戰結束時降至兩萬出頭。1945 年 8 月 15 日日本宣布接受宣言，9 月 2 日簽署投降書，9 月 9 日在南京舉行中國戰區受降典禮。兩個打擊點的座標分別是廣島約在東經 132.45、北緯 34.39，長崎約在東經 129.87、北緯 32.75，卡面地圖落點取前者。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers cluster in a few places. The test shot was carried out in the early morning of 16 July 1945 at the Alamogordo Army Air Field in New Mexico; the yield estimates most often quoted fall between fifteen and twenty-one kilotons, and the accounts differ. The strike on Hiroshima took place at 8:15 a.m. on 6 August, the Enola Gay releasing the uranium weapon from about nine thousand four hundred and fifty metres with twelve men aboard; besides the strike aircraft, a B-25 and a dozen or more B-29s flew that day on visual confirmation and photographic reconnaissance. The strike on Nagasaki was at 11:02 a.m. on 9 August, Bockscar releasing the plutonium weapon from about eight thousand five hundred metres; three B-29s were dispatched, with two more carrying instrumentation. The total strength of the 509th Composite Group was about eight thousand men, aircrew and ground personnel together. On the production side, Colt's M1911 family had reached roughly one and a half million pistols by the end of production in 1945, with seven rounds to each .45 calibre magazine. The Manhattan Engineer District employed more than one hundred thousand people at its peak. The post-war nuclear stockpile tables show the United States holding only the two devices already used at the end of 1945, with warhead numbers peaking above thirty thousand in the mid-1960s and falling to a little over twenty thousand when the Cold War ended in 1989. Japan announced acceptance of the declaration on 15 August 1945, signed the instrument of surrender on 2 September, and the surrender ceremony for the China Theatre was held at Nanjing on 9 September. The two strike points sit at roughly 132.45 east and 34.39 north for Hiroshima and 129.87 east and 32.75 north for Nagasaki, and the map pin on the card is placed on the former.
cause: 打起來的原因是太平洋戰爭打到第四年，雙方都沒有可以退讓的餘地。1945 年 7 月的貝爾森會議與 7 月 26 日的波茨坦宣言裡，盟國對日本投降的條款表述並不一致，蘇聯沒有承諾在對日作戰中投入地面部隊，原子彈於是成為改變局面的一手。7 月 16 日試爆成功，7 月下旬杜魯門在波茨坦提及新型武器，8 月 4 日與 5 日的命令鏈把決策落成行動：目標選在廣島與長崎，一處是陸軍的兵工廠與船廠群，一處是海軍的造船設施與軍港，都是帝國本土難以用常規手段貫穿的節點。8 月 8 日夜蘇軍進入滿洲，日本政府同時要處理內外交攻，時間表被壓到最後。此外還有一層制度上的原因：一個新種類的武器若要真正發揮作用，必須先有承接它的部隊、廠房與指揮系統，而這套東西在 1945 年 8 月之前只以試驗器材的形式存在。
causeEn: The reason it came to blows is that the Pacific War was in its fourth year and neither side had room to give ground. At the July 1945 conference at Malta and in the Potsdam Declaration of 26 July, the allied wording on Japan's surrender was not uniform, and the Soviet Union had given no commitment to put ground troops into the war against Japan, so the atomic bomb became the one card that could change the position. The test on 16 July succeeded; President Truman referred to the new weapon at Potsdam in late July; and the chain of orders on 4 and 5 August turned a decision into action. The targets were Hiroshima and Nagasaki: one a cluster of army ordnance plants and shipyards, the other naval construction works and a naval base, in both cases nodes on the home islands that conventional means could not readily break. The entry of Soviet troops into Manchuria on the night of 8 August left the Japanese government under attack from within and from outside, and the timetable was squeezed to the last. There is also an institutional reason: for a new kind of weapon to have real effect it needs formations, plants and a command system built to carry it, and until August 1945 all of that existed only in the form of test equipment.
impact: 最直接的影響是名冊的性質改變了。此後大國之間不敢再直接對撞，衝突被推到代理戰爭與區域戰爭的層面，這套邏輯在此後四十年裡一直是國際秩序的地基。核武庫的膨脹把工業與國家預算一起拉進來：鈾濃縮與鈽生產設施、四發動機的重型轟炸機、洲際彈道轟炸機與相應的預警與指揮體系，都由同一條技術鏈生出來。軍控體系也由此起步，1963 年的部分禁止核試驗條約、1968 年的不擴散條約、1972 年與 1979 年的限額條約以及 1987 年的中導條約，構成冷戰後期約束武器競賽的骨幹。對日本而言，1947 年憲法第九條放棄戰爭權力與保留的安保體制，塑造了往後二十年的防衛框架。對本站的歷史頁而言，這一節點的意義是把視線從常規兵器推到天花板：核武在天花板上，下面仍然是步槍、戰車、砲兵與飛機在解決問題。冷戰期間的局部戰爭，韓戰初期的美軍步兵仍配發 M1911A1，直到 1950 年代中後期 M9 才逐步接手；越戰期間 M1911 仍在名冊上，說明新武器並不替換舊武器，而是長期並存。
impactEn: The most direct effect was a change in the nature of the roster. From then on the great powers did not collide directly, and disputes were pushed down to proxy war and regional war, and that logic remained the foundation of the international order for the next four decades. The growth of the nuclear stockpile pulled heavy industry and state budgets in with it: the separation and production plants, the four-engine heavy bomber, the intercontinental ballistic bomber and the warning and command systems to match were all products of the same technical chain. The arms control architecture grew out of it as well, with the 1963 Partial Test Ban Treaty, the 1968 Non-Proliferation Treaty, the limitation agreements of 1972 and 1979 and the 1987 Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty forming the backbone that constrained the arms race in the later Cold War. For Japan, Article Nine of the 1947 constitution renouncing the right to wage war, together with the security arrangements that were retained, shaped the defence framework of the following two decades. For this site's history screen the node means that the eye is lifted from conventional weapons to the ceiling: the nuclear weapon is the ceiling, and underneath it rifles, tanks, artillery and aircraft still settle the questions. In the local wars of the Cold War, US infantry at the start of the Korean War were still issued the M1911A1, and the M9 only took over progressively in the mid and late 1950s; through the Vietnam War the M1911 was still on the roster, which shows that new weapons do not replace old ones, they coexist with them for a long time.
result: 結果是日本政府於 8 月 10 日決定接受宣言的附帶條件，8 月 15 日天皇以廣播宣布停戰，9 月 2 日簽署投降書，9 月 9 日在南京舉行中國戰區受降典禮，同時蘇軍在滿洲的攻勢持續推進到投降生效。對美軍而言，核武從試驗器材正式成為獨立兵種的裝備，核武庫從兩件起步，之後是二十年的核軍與常規軍並行。對 M1911 來說，這一場並沒有改變它的功能，只改變了它在名冊上的位置：手槍照舊是每個步兵與警衛的副武器，而名冊上從此多了一件以數量而非命中率取勝的裝備。佔領軍進入日本時腰間仍然是 M1911，1950 年代起才逐步換成 M9，到 1980 年代美軍正式把 M9 定為標準手槍，M1911 退入後備並在隨後二十年間被各國軍隊繼續採用。歷史頁的下一個節點因此是冷戰：核威懾決定大國不直接對撞，局部戰爭仍按常規規則打下去。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Japanese government decided on 10 August to accept the declaration with its stated conditions, the Emperor announced the cessation of hostilities by radio broadcast on 15 August, the instrument of surrender was signed on 2 September, and the surrender ceremony for the China Theatre was held at Nanjing on 9 September, while the Soviet offensive in Manchuria continued until the surrender took effect. For the US armed forces the nuclear weapon moved from being a test item to being equipment of a separate service arm, with the stockpile starting from two devices and followed by two decades of nuclear and conventional forces existing side by side. For the M1911 the engagement changed nothing about its function; it changed only its place on the roster: the pistol remained the sidearm of every infantryman and sentry, while the roster now also carried an item that won by quantity rather than by hit rate. The occupation troops entering Japan still had the M1911 on their hip, the M9 replaced it progressively only from the 1950s, and by the 1980s the US military had formally standardised on the M9, with the M1911 moving into reserve and continuing to be used by armed forces abroad over the following twenty years. The next node on the history screen is therefore the Cold War: nuclear deterrence decides that the great powers do not collide directly, while local wars go on being fought by the ordinary rules.
